en.role: Deputy Prime Minister for Sports, Tourism, and Youth Policy
en.quote: We have never had a national doping system, and no one will ever produce a single fact against the state system.
en.head: Investigations found involvement by state bodies.
en.body: An independent WADA investigation described an institutional doping cover-up involving Sports Ministry officials and other state bodies. On 5 December 2017, the IOC suspended the Russian Olympic Committee from the PyeongChang Games. Those findings substantially diverge from the categorical denial of a system; they do not by themselves establish Mutko’s personal guilt.

osrc.t: Reuters on CAS lifting Mutko’s ban, July 11, 2019
